rows.text: Authority for a third party to make an enquiry on your behalf

Use this form where you are making enquiries of the Ministry of Defence on behalf of another person and the subject matter involved, or nature of response required, is likely to include special category personal data. Examples include enquiries where a response might disclose information on the other person’s: • Physical or mental health • Sexual activities of sexual orientation. • Racial or ethnic origin • Political opinions • Religious or philosophical beliefs • Trade Union membership Such information will only be disclosed to the extent necessary to provide a meaningful and proportionate response to your enquiry.

See https://www.gov.uk/guidance/contact- the-ministry-of-defence for more details on acceptable forms of ID. This declaration will remain in place until your enquiry is concluded. You may withdraw this authority at any time by contacting us again.)

context:
Entirely fictional case. All people, identifiers, contact details, decisions and signatures are synthetic and do not represent a real submission.
Fictional Jamie North authorises friend Robin Vale to enquire about pension correspondence SYN908. Both provide fictional identification with the enquiry; the authority stays effective until conclusion unless withdrawn.
